name: Alpha Vantage
label: Alpha Vantage
description: Alpha Vantage official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: quote, time_series_intraday, time_series_daily, time_series_weekly, search, fx_rate, crypto_daily. Docs: https://www.alphavantage.co/documentation/. Alpha Vantage terms. Free key: 25 requests/day (https://www.alphavantage.co/support/). TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY is Premium. TIME_SERIES_DAILY outputsize=full is premium-only (compact is free). Realtime and 15-minute delayed US market data are premium. Not for redistribution as a competing feed. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Alpha Vantage request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"quote"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: quote | time_series_intraday | time_series_daily | time_series_weekly | search | fx_rate | crypto_daily. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'quote'.

schema.label: from_currency
schema.description: From currency for fx. Example: USD.

schema.label: market
schema.description: Crypto market quote currency. Example: USD.

schema.label: outputsize
schema.description: TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY / DAILY outputsize. EXACT: compact | full.

schema.label: symbol
schema.description: Ticker for quote / time_series_* / symbol_search. Example: IBM.

schema.label: to_currency
schema.description: To currency for fx. Example: EUR.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: quote, time_series_intraday, time_series_daily, time_series_weekly, search, fx_rate, crypto_daily.

configurationParameters.label: Apikey
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
